ns0:g.ns0:text: Two plies / schematic enlargement - not to scale
Four-thread construction: two needle positions plus
two looper positions. Confirm the machine formation
before using an ISO stitch code.
Three-thread edge finish: use the machine-approved
needle configuration for a soft free edge. This finish
does not replace the structural join.

ns0:g.ns0:text: Guide without pulling. Differential feed is adjusted on the coupon to remove waves without gathering the garment. Avoid needle cuts, exposed loops and excessive tension that
limits extension. Secure chain tails through the seam with a blunt needle where the machine method permits; inspect for unraveling. Production threads are black; colors here
identify roles. Sources: AE, COATS, PEGASUS.
